scientific_conclusion: The current project now has an executable manifest-topology gate for equal-evidence Velvia 50, Portra 400 and Ektar 100 acquisition. It requires same digital references and capture conditions across stocks, two development rolls plus one group-held confirmation roll per stock, independent process and scanner sessions, repeated development scans, declared rights and lineage, and sealed confirmation groups. Passing this gate opens only a separate file, decoded-pixel, alignment and rights-integrity audit; K=1 fitting remains closed until that audit passes.
next_mainline: Populate this manifest only from project-owned controlled captures or a genuinely new public cohort with equivalent rights and grouping. Until then retain the RF3.D1 data gap and do not substitute proxy algorithms, AO6 transfer, retrieval, routing or K greater than 1.
claim_ceiling: Executable controlled-acquisition manifest-topology protocol and validator only. No acquired data, file or pixel integrity, fitting authority, stock response, calibrated profile, preference result, package, capability or product promotion.
